description: Create an approver key for the person who approves held actions (shown once). Give it to that person, never to an agent: once a project has an approver, the admin key can no longer approve.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...
